opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search (origin, destination, dates, trip type)
opportunities.description: Search jetblue.com for flights by setting origin, destination, departure date and optional return date, then continue past the same-day-flight notice to the results list.
steps: Open the JetBlue flight search (Flights tab).
Set trip type (Roundtrip or One-way) from the dropdown next to the search box.
Click the From field, type the origin city, and pick the matching suggestion.
Click the To field, type the destination city, and pick the matching suggestion.
Click Depart and choose the departure day in the calendar.
If a return is needed, click Return and choose the return day; otherwise keep One-way.
Click Search flights.
In the 'Flying today?' or 'proof of return travel' notice, click Continue to flight results.
parameters: origin city (e.g. new york, New York City area (NYC), Columbus)

instances.values: From New York JFK -> To Miami MIA; depart Mon Mar 27, return Fri Mar 31 (roundtrip, 1 adult)
From New York City area (NYC) -> To Toronto YYZ; switched to one-way, depart Sat Apr 29
From New York City area (NYC) -> To Aruba AUA; depart Mon May 1, return Fri May 5 (points search via Use TrueBlue points)

opportunities.name: United car rental search (pickup city, dates, times)
opportunities.description: Search United's Car tab for a rental by entering pickup city, pickup and drop-off dates and times, then click Find cars.
steps: Click the CAR tab on the United booking widget.
Click the Pickup location field, type the city, and choose the matching suggestion.
Click the Pickup date field and choose the start day in the calendar.
Click the drop-off date and choose the end day.
Open the Pickup time dropdown and choose the time (if different from default).
Open the Drop off time dropdown and choose the time (if different from default).
Click Find cars.
parameters: pickup city (e.g. Caldwell (Ohio), Brooklyn - Central (New York))

instances.values: Pickup Caldwell (Ohio), US; Apr 8 - Apr 13; pickup 8:00 a.m., drop-off 12:00 p.m. (Book with miles checked)
Pickup Brooklyn - Central (New York), US; Apr 9 - Apr 15; default 10:00 a.m. times

opportunities.name: Budget job-openings search (country, team, time type)
opportunities.description: Open Avis Budget's careers Openings page and filter jobs by country, team and time type, then optionally open a result and apply.
steps: Click Careers in the footer, then click Openings.
Click the Country filter and choose the country option.
Click the Team filter and choose the team option.
Click the Time Type filter and choose Full time or Part time.
Click Search by job title or keyword.
Click a matching job title in the results.
Click Apply Now on the job page.

instances.values: Country United States of America; Team Finance; Time Type Full time; opened Accounts Payable Associate and clicked Apply Now
Country United States of America; Team Finance; Time Type Full time

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park search by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov Find a Park, open the search-by-activity-or-topic view, choose an activity or topic from its filter, and run Search to list parks.
steps: Click FIND A PARK on the homepage.
Click Search by Activity or Topic.
Open the Activity or Topic dropdown and select the value (tick the checkbox).
Click the filter input to close the list if needed.
Click Search.

opportunities.name: JetBlue hotel search (destination, dates, guests)
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue/Paisly hotels by destination, check-in and check-out dates and number of guests, then run the search.
steps: Click the Search location field and type the destination city.
Choose the matching city from the suggestions.
Click the date range field and pick the check-in and check-out days.
Click the rooms and guests field, adjust adults and children (with child ages) and click Update.
Click Search.
If a sign-in prompt appears, click Search without signing in.
Open Sort or choose a sort order (e.g. Price low to high) and click a hotel.

instances.values: Texas City, TX; Apr 22 - Apr 25; 1 room, 2 guests
Texas City, TX; Apr 22 - Apr 25; 1 room, 3 adults and 1 child age 6, sorted by price low to high

opportunities.name: Retailer product search with max-price filter
opportunities.description: Search a retailer site for a product keyword, set a maximum price, and add a matching item to the cart.
steps: Click the site's search box and type the product keyword, then press search.
Enter the maximum price in the price filter's max field.
Click Go (or Apply) to filter results.
Click ADD TO CART on the wanted product (or open it and click Add to Cart).
parameters: product keyword (e.g. swivel vacuum, wireless headphones)

instances.values: Menards: keyword 'swivel vacuum', max price 150, added a Hoover item to cart
Amazon: keyword 'wireless headphones', max price 100, added an EAORUL headphone to cart

opportunities.name: JetBlue flight results sort by price
opportunities.description: On the JetBlue results page, open Sort & Filter, change the sort order to price, and apply.
steps: Click Sort & Filter on the results page.
Open the Sort dropdown and choose a sort option (e.g. Price low to high or Price by Core).
Click Apply.
parameters: sort option (Price (low to high), Price by Core)

instances.values: Sort: Price (low to high), departure airports LGA and JFK

opportunities.name: MTA toll rates lookup by vehicle type
opportunities.description: Navigate the MTA site to bridge and tunnel toll rates and pick a vehicle type to view its rates.
steps: Open the site menu or Fares & Tolls.
Click Bridges & Tunnels (or Bridges and Tunnels tolls).
Click Tolls by vehicle or Toll Rates.
Click the vehicle type tile (Cars, Motorcycles, Trucks).
Open the crossing's rate table.

instances.values: Vehicle type: Motorcycles (via Fares & Tolls > Bridges and Tunnels tolls > Toll Rates)
